description: Department of Fisheries & Acquatic Resources - Notifying the list of Fisheries Management Committees registered for Kokilai Lagoon Fisheries Management Area
reasoning: This gazette notification is made under the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No. 2 of 1996, and announces the establishment and registration of Fisheries Management Committees. This constitutes a regulatory action and the publication of a legal notice under an existing Act, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). It does not involve government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, or public service matters.
